title: Everything advertisers want to know about FAST TV, answered

facts.fact: FAST TV grew 262 times faster than the TV streaming market as a whole in 2025, according to Roku Advertising.
facts.quote: 262 times faster than the TV streaming market as a whole in 2025

facts.fact: Roku Advertising states that 64% of U.S. Roku households stream FAST content.
facts.quote: Today, 64% of U.S. Roku households stream FAST content.

facts.fact: The Roku Channel offers more than 550 live linear channels in the U.S.
facts.quote: The Roku Channel offers 550+ live linear channels in the U.S., with more than 80,000 movies and TV shows available free.

facts.fact: The Roku Channel offers more than 80,000 movies and TV shows free to viewers.
facts.quote: with more than 80,000 movies and TV shows available free

facts.fact: Comscore reports that total FAST hours watched reached 1.8 billion in August 2025, up 43% year-over-year.
facts.quote: Total FAST hours watched reached 1.8 billion in August 2025, surging 43% year-over-year (Comscore).

facts.fact: EMARKETER projects the U.S. FAST-viewing audience to reach 131.4 million in 2026, representing 54% of all CTV users.
facts.quote: The FAST-viewing audience in the US is projected to reach 131.4 million in 2026 — representing 54% of all CTV users (EMARKETER).

facts.fact: According to Nielsen Gauge, The Roku Channel captured 3% of all U.S. TV watch time as of April 2026.
facts.quote: The Roku Channel, which offers both FAST and AVOD experiences, captured 3% of all TV watch time in the US as of April 2026 (Nielsen Gauge).

facts.fact: Roku's How America Streams data (May 2025) shows that more than half of Americans stream FAST content in every US region.
facts.quote: Roku's _How America Streams_ data (May 2025) shows that more than half of Americans stream FAST content in every US region.

facts.fact: Free TV accounts for 60% of total TV time in the South, the region where it is most prevalent.
facts.quote: Free TV is most prevalent in the South, accounting for 60% of total TV time.

facts.fact: Nationally, 46% of US internet households regularly use FAST services.
facts.quote: Nationally, 46% of US internet households regularly use FAST services.

facts.fact: Deloitte data shows more than two-thirds of younger viewers stream at least one FAST channel.
facts.quote: Deloitte data shows more than two-thirds of younger viewers stream at least one FAST channel.

facts.fact: Roku data shows that 57% of households that streamed only ad-free content in 2020 now watch FAST.
facts.quote: Roku data shows that 57% of households that streamed only ad-free content in 2020 now watch FAST.

facts.fact: Sports programming on FAST channels grew 30% year-over-year in Q1 2026, according to Gracenote.
facts.quote: Sports programming on FAST channels grew 30% year-over-year in Q1 2026 (Gracenote)

facts.fact: Roku reaches 125 million daily active users in the U.S., and Roku OS is in more than half of U.S. broadband households.
facts.quote: Roku reaches 125 million daily active users in the U.S., and Roku OS is in more than half of U.S. broadband households.

facts.fact: Roku launched its first FAST channels in the UK in 2025.
facts.quote: Roku launched its first FAST channels in the UK in 2025.

facts.fact: The Amazon partnership, announced June 2025, creates a CTV footprint covering over 80% of US connected TV households, according to Roku Advertising.
facts.quote: The Amazon partnership, announced June 2025, creates a CTV footprint covering over 80% of US connected TV households.

facts.fact: Roku Advertising says FAST users see roughly one-third of the ad load typical of cable audiences (Roku x Horizon Futures Group, 2026).
facts.quote: FAST users see roughly one-third of the ad load typical of cable audiences (Roku x Horizon Futures Group, 2026).

facts.fact: The Roku Channel operates at approximately 8 minutes of ads per hour, compared to linear cable's 14–16 minutes per hour, according to Roku Advertising.
facts.quote: The Roku Channel operates at approximately 8 minutes of ads per hour, compared to linear cable’s 14–16 minutes.

facts.fact: Roku Advertising reports that half of streamers say FAST has personal favorites they like to revisit.
facts.quote: half of streamers say FAST has personal favorites they like to revisit

facts.fact: Roku's proprietary targeting offers location targeting down to the ZIP code level for campaigns.
facts.quote: Campaigns can target down to the ZIP code
